reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per competitor price check of an Earbuds product
  SELECT cp.product_id, cp.competitor, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.product_id ORDER BY cp.observed_ts DESC, cp.competitor) AS rn
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 16
)
SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
alternatives:
SELECT cp.product_id, cp.competitor, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur
FROM competitor_prices cp
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
WHERE p.category_id = 16
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM competitor_prices cp2
    WHERE cp2.product_id = cp.product_id
      AND (cp2.observed_ts > cp.observed_ts OR (cp2.observed_ts = cp.observed_ts AND cp2.competitor < cp.competitor))
  )

SELECT t.product_id, t.competitor, t.observed_ts, t.price_eur
FROM (
  -- one row per competitor price check of an Earbuds product
  SELECT cp.product_id, cp.competitor, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.product_id ORDER BY cp.observed_ts DESC, cp.competitor) AS rn
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 16
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1

solver.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT cp.product_id, cp.competitor, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.product_id ORDER BY cp.observed_ts DESC, cp.competitor ASC) AS rn
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = 16
)
SELECT product_id, competitor, observed_ts, price_eur
FROM r
WHERE rn = 1
